entities.name: Jørgen Matthias Christian Schiødte
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jørgen Matthias Christian Schiødte or Jørgen Christian Matthias Schiødte was a Danish entomologist, professor and museum curator. His special interest was in the beetles but he also worked on other arthropods. He was also a trained illustrator and copperplate engraver.
